• 8+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 3 in lifecycle, customer or growth marketing

• A track record of always-on lifecycle programs that moved activation, expansion or retention

• Experience building segmentation, cohort and account scoring models, and turning them into triggers and journeys

• Strong creative judgment for formats, channels and communications that make our programs stand out

• Working knowledge of HubSpot (or a similar platform) and Intercom, and of how product usage data drives triggers and segmentation

• Comfort turning data into decisions, writing requirements, and briefing an engineer on what to build

• Hands-on use of AI to automate workflows

• Experience in travel, tourism or destination marketing is a plus
